REBOUNDOPS / LOCAL DEVELOPER PREVIEW

Getting started

Install once, start the local developer preview and complete a fictional first journey.

On this pageSupported preview scopeBefore you beginInstall and runYour first five minutesContinue the same recovery sessionIf something does not start

Supported preview scope

Linux/macOS local developer preview. Native Windows is experimental pending manual acceptance; its fresh-start, stop and restart CI check remains a required gate. This is not a hosted service or a validated broad beta. No participants are recruited for the current validation round yet.

Before you begin

Install Git, npm and a supported Node.js runtime. Node 24.15+ on the 24.x line is recommended; the root application also supports Node 22.22.3+ and Node 26+. Use your usual terminal on macOS, Linux or Windows. Run npm run doctor to check prerequisites and ports.

Install and run

1. Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/AnkitParekh007/rebound-ops.git
2. Start the workspace
cd rebound-ops
npm start

Wait until your terminal says ReboundOps is running. Keep it open while you use the workspace.

Open the workspace guide

The guide connects your plan, evidence, CV, sources, applications and backups. The first launch installs dependencies and checks Chromium for PDF export. AI stays off by default. Press Ctrl+C in the terminal when you want to stop.

Your first five minutes

  1. Choose Use a fictional example on the start screen.
  2. Review the experience and available time, then choose Compare my directions.
  3. Explore directions and select one to test.
  4. Open the search workbench, browse opportunities and inspect the application tracker.

The example is synthetic. Visible application statuses and job scores demonstrate the interface; they are not customer outcomes.

Continue the same recovery session

The launcher serves both interfaces together. In Start or My next step, choose Open full recovery: evidence, check-in and data controls. This opens the same session with its existing answers and progress. No restart or repeated intake is needed. The full recovery interface runs on http://127.0.0.1:4174; the workspace remains on port 4317.

If something does not start

First-time setup needs network access for packages and Chromium. If startup reports missing Linux browser libraries, run npx playwright install --with-deps chromium from engine/, then retry. Startup stops before services launch when a prerequisite check fails.

  • Port in use: stop another ReboundOps process. The integrated workspace uses ports 4317 and 4174; Angular development uses 4200 and 4174.
  • Recovery service offline: check the launcher terminal and restart both services with npm start.
  • Unsupported Node version: check node --version against the requirements above, then reinstall with npm ci.
  • Session gone after restart: memory-only sessions do not survive API restarts. Read Data and backups before using personal records.

More detail: integrated workspace guide ↗. Report problems with your OS, Node version and redacted error text; exclude private records and keys.
